paras: Tropidophorus partelloi, also known commonly as Partello's waterside skink, is a species of lizard in the subfamily Sphenomorphinae of the family Scincidae. The species is endemic to the Philippines.
The specific name, partelloi, is in honor of United States Army officer Joseph McDowell Trimble Partello (1851–1934), who served in the Philippines.
In the Philippines, Tropidophorus partelloi is found on the island of Mindanao.
The preferred natural habitat of Tropidophorus partelloi is forest, at elevations of 450–1,200 m (1,480–3,940 ft).
Tropidophorus partelloi is terrestrial, sheltering ynder logs and rocks.
